                    LAND & LEDGERS
     CANONICAL PROJECT BIBLE - REVISION XXXI
                THE CROSSING Full-Systems Playtest Integration
   Generic Business Architecture, Universal Production, Contact-Graph Hiring, River Enterprise, Historical Event Control &
                                     Autonomous Settlement Growth

                                            Revision date: October 7, 2026
                      Source baseline: Canonical Project Bible Revision XXX - October 5, 2026
Primary new source: THE CROSSING autonomous full-systems playtest and post-playtest generic-business synthesis - 2026
                                               Status: Active Canon integration

PRESERVATION GUARANTEE
Revision XXXI preserves Canonical Project Bible Revision XXX in full except where this integration explicitly adds,
deepens, clarifies, corrects or supersedes prior wording. The complete Revision XXX document follows this integration
unchanged as the preserved historical layer. Where a conflict exists, Revision XXXI controls. Exact playtest prices,
wages, rents, construction costs, land prices, vessel prices, traffic counts, hatch rates, flock thresholds, interest rates,
business margins, completion dates and late-campaign accounting totals remain calibration unless this revision
explicitly promotes the underlying rule to Canon.

PURPOSE
Revision XXXI integrates THE CROSSING, a 1870 northern-Dakota river-crossing scenario that began with one player,
one cabin, $500 cash and no local service town, then developed through ferrying, retail, smithing, property
development, construction, lumber, freight, warehousing, independent NPC enterprise, river transport and full portfolio
delegation. The playtest completed all authored goals while the player ultimately managed zero ordinary businesses.
The central architectural result is a stronger symmetry between Persons and Businesses: occupation describes a
Person but does not mechanically define every task they may attempt; a Business label describes an enterprise but
does not mechanically define every activity it may operate. Actual people, physical resources, legal rights, agreements,
information and time remain authoritative.

REVISION XXXI MASTER DOCTRINE
 • ROLE DESCRIBES; STATE PERMITS. A Person occupation is descriptive rather than a class gate, and a Business
   label is descriptive rather than a business-class gate. Physical, economic, legal and relational state controls what
  can actually occur.
 • Create Business creates a generic legal/economic Business authority. BusinessOperation, CommercialCapability,
  BusinessCapabilityRegistry or successor records may organize or describe current activity, but may never become
  replacement hard classes or permission flags.
 • For ordinary production, any Person may attempt a task when its physical prerequisites are available. Competence
  changes time, quality, waste, failure, rework and safety rather than granting the button. Worker agency, law and
   contract remain separate reasons an assignment may be refused or prohibited.
 • Production is object/method-centric. ProductionMethod plus inputs, equipment, workspace, labor/time and conditions
  determine feasible execution. Workshops and business labels do not own arbitrary recipe whitelists.
 • Recruitment is contact- and evidence-driven. Add Employee exposes actual known/contactable Persons and
   legitimate recruitment channels, not a world-wide omniscient applicant pool.
 • Full delegation can free the player completely from ordinary operations. Managers act through the same Tasks,
  Agreements, cash, inventory, equipment, information and authority as any other actor; autonomy creates no hidden
   efficiency.
 • Vertical integration removes outside transactions only when real internal capacity replaces them. It never creates free
  goods, duplicate capacity or consolidated profit.
 • Historical Events are configurable. The default is ON; disabling a named authored event prevents that authored
  event from injecting its causal inputs but does not disable endogenous recessions, weather, disease, fire or other
   ordinary simulation outcomes.
 • Scenario objectives observe authoritative state and ownership. They never spawn people, enterprises, cargo,
  passengers or capital and must distinguish player-controlled, jointly owned and genuinely independent NPC
  businesses when the wording requires it.

PART I - AUTHORITY, SUPERSESSION & CALIBRATION

1.1 Playtest findings versus generated numbers
CANON LOCK - THE CROSSING promotes repeatable causal rules, not its generated dollar amounts or success path.
A playtest value may remain useful calibration evidence without becoming a universal wage, rent, land price,
construction quote, vessel price, hatch rate, capacity, profitability or timing constant.

1.2 Role describes; state permits
CANON LOCK - Person occupation and Business label are both descriptive layers over deeper state. Occupation does
not grant a universal action list. Business name/type does not grant a universal commercial action list. Actual Persons,
equipment, workspace, inventory, property rights, agreements, legal authority, information, route access, capital and
time determine what can be attempted or operated.

1.3 Descriptive records may not become hidden classes
BusinessOperation, CommercialCapability, BusinessCapabilityRegistry, occupation profiles, tags, templates and similar
records may support UI organization, manager reasoning, analytics or authoring. They do not become independent
permission authorities. A renamed or newly composed descriptive record must not recreate the rigid class system this
revision removes.

1.4 Worker agency remains independent
"Any Person may attempt" means the simulation does not mechanically forbid an ordinary production task merely
because the Person lacks the expected occupation or skill. It does not mean an employee must obey. A Person can
refuse, negotiate, abandon, escalate or report work because of employment terms, danger, relationships, fatigue,
legality, conscience, authority or other ordinary causes.

1.5 Reconciled state still controls exact claims
Revision XXX state-discipline doctrine remains controlling. THE CROSSING also exposed small ledger-presentation
discrepancies, reinforcing that narration cannot make unreconciled balances authoritative. Corrections require explicit
provenance or replay; repeated downstream use is not reconciliation.

PART II - GENERIC BUSINESS, RETAIL & OPERATING IDENTITY

2.1 Create Business creates a generic economic entity
CANON LOCK - The ordinary Create Business action creates Business identity, ownership/governance and the
legal/economic ledger relationship. It does not require choosing Blacksmith, General Store, Sawmill, Saddlery,
Construction Company, Freight Company, Pharmacy or another hard business class. Formation costs arise only from
real legal, property, equipment, inventory, staffing, finance and working-capital requirements.

2.2 Business form follows actual function - completed
The existing Canon rule that business form follows actual function is extended to its logical conclusion. A Business
behaves as a retailer because it offers inventory for sale; as a smithing operation because it possesses and uses forge
resources; as a carrier because it controls transport assets and sells transport; as a landlord because it owns/controls
property and leases space; and as a mixed enterprise when several such activities coexist.


                                          LAND & LEDGERS  2

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 003/346 ====================

2.3 Labels, templates and inferred identity
Player-facing names such as General Store, Smith & Repair, Sawmill, Saddlery or Transportation & River Company
remain useful. Templates may suggest premises, equipment, supplier lines, stock policies or workflows. Inferred labels
may summarize what an enterprise mostly does. None of these may be authoritative for what actions are available.

2.4 Retail and storefront
Retail means that a Business legitimately possesses inventory and offers some of it for sale through an accessible
selling arrangement. The inventory may be purchased finished goods, internally manufactured output, farm output,
processed food, salvage, used equipment, materials or other lawful goods. A broad assortment may be described as a
General Store; a narrow assortment may be described as grocery, hardware, feed, produce or dry goods.
Storefront describes physical customer-facing commercial space, not a business class. Retail can also occur from a
workshop, yard, warehouse, landing, home, wagon, stall or other physically valid place.

2.5 Opening, operation and profitability remain separate facts
CANON LOCK - Creating a Business record does not make it operating. A Business opens only when the actual
people, time, space where needed, stock/equipment, legal/contract authority, access and transaction path needed for
its real activity exist. Building completion, Business opening and profitability remain distinct states. Do not replace this
with a hidden Capability=true opening gate.

2.6 One Business may combine activities
One Business may buy/resell goods, manufacture, repair, provide services, rent property, warehouse, haul freight,
operate a ferry and provide river transport when its actual resources and agreements support those activities. Activities
remain distinct for capacity and accounting even when they share one Business ledger.

2.7 Enterprise grouping versus reorganization
Administrative enterprise/portfolio grouping does not merge the member Businesses. A true merger/reorganization
changes legal/economic ownership, cash authority, assets, liabilities, employees and contracts according to actual
agreements and creditor requirements. Predecessor history remains.

PART III - UNIVERSAL PRODUCTION, TASK EXECUTION & INTERNAL SUPPLY

3.1 Universal production permission
CANON LOCK - For ordinary production and repair, the simulation may not use occupation or specialist capability as a
universal hard permission gate. If the physical method can be attempted with the available materials, equipment,
workspace and time, any Person may be assigned to attempt it. This supersedes preserved wording that could be read
as requiring specialist capability merely to attempt ordinary production.

3.2 ProductionMethod is the causal center
Each producible object may expose one or more ProductionMethods. A method can define inputs, tools/equipment,
workspace, task sequence, labor/time, environmental tolerances, output quantity/quality, waste paths, rework and
safety risks. The available catalog is resolved from methods and state, not from a workshop class or occupation recipe
list.

3.3 Competence changes execution
Capability, experience, instruction, supervision, task difficulty, equipment condition, material quality, fatigue,
environment and time pressure may alter speed, quality, consistency, waste, failure, injury and rework. Novice work is
therefore possible without being equally effective.

3.4 Production policy
A manager/player may configure item-level standing policy such as Enabled, Target Stock, Maximum Stock, Priority,
Minimum Input Reserve, Make to Stock, Make to Order, External Sale, Internal Orders and customer-order priority.
These controls organize work; they do not manufacture capacity.

3.5 Shared physical capacity remains exclusive
A forge, saw, wagon, workbench, worker, stall, bay or workspace cannot satisfy two simultaneous incompatible tasks
because multiple operations reference it. Stocked production competes with customer work and internal projects for the
same labor and equipment time.

3.6 Internal supply is real production
Smith-made nails, mill-made lumber, internal construction and controlled freight are valid vertical integration only when
they consume real inputs, labor, equipment capacity, transport and time. Internal transfer pricing may be zero, at cost
or another supported amount, but consolidated reporting eliminates manufactured internal revenue/profit.

                                          LAND & LEDGERS  3

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 004/346 ====================

3.7 Free owner labor reduces cash cost, not creates revenue
Owner-performed labor can reduce the cash expenditure needed to complete a task. It does not create a fictional
wage, sale or mark-up that increases consolidated wealth merely because the owner worked.

PART IV - CONTACT-GRAPH HIRING, EVIDENCE & EMPLOYMENT

4.1 Add Employee uses actual contactability
CANON LOCK - The ordinary employee-selection surface should expose actual Persons the recruiting actor can
legitimately contact or reach through a real channel. It must not expose an omniscient global labor list.
 • Directly met or previously corresponded Person.
 • Employee, associate, supplier, customer, family, friend or former coworker referral.
 • Person who answered a handbill, newspaper advertisement or other recruitment campaign.
 • Person whose address or contact path was legitimately supplied by another actor.
 • Person reached through local businesses, travel networks, mail, messenger or telegraph where available.

4.2 Clicking a stranger does not grant omniscience
World interaction may allow Observe, Approach, Introduce Yourself, Ask Name, Ask About Work or similar actions.
Merely clicking an unknown Person does not reveal hidden identity, address, occupation or capabilities. Contact and
evidence must be acquired.

4.3 Recruitment channels create awareness and response
Mail, word of mouth, in-person visits, sent messengers/employees, handbills, newspaper advertisements and telegraph
are information channels with cost, reach and latency. They can produce a lead or no lead; recipients may reply,
ignore, negotiate, visit or decline.

4.4 Known skills are evidence, not full stats
Candidate UI should lead with capabilities relevant to the current role, followed by other known general evidence.
Unknown capabilities remain unknown. References, work history, observation and practical demonstrations change
evidence/confidence rather than directly exposing hidden truth.

4.5 Capability confidence rendering remains exact
CANON LOCK - Human capability bands remain Ordinary -> Great -> Excellent -> Mastered. High confidence displays
exactly one band; Moderate exactly two adjacent bands; Low exactly three adjacent bands; insufficient evidence
displays Not enough information. A single-band reading paired with Moderate or Low confidence is invalid.

4.6 Employment offers are agreements
Employment offers may specify wage/pay, housing or board, trial/probation, guaranteed versus conditional
employment, start date, expected duties, authority and other real terms. Housing, employment, tenancy and ownership
remain distinct relationships unless the agreement explicitly links them.

4.7 Relationship provenance should persist
The world should retain who introduced whom and by what channel. The same relationship graph can support hiring,
tenant leads, suppliers, land sellers, lenders, business partners, specialists and migration chains.

PART V - DELEGATION, MANAGEMENT & OWNER ATTENTION

5.1 Zero personally managed businesses is fully supported
Revision XXX full-autonomy doctrine is validated and deepened. The player may act only as proprietor/investor while
managers continue ordinary staffing, procurement, production, scheduling, pricing within policy, maintenance,
collections, customer service, contracting, property development and opportunity response.

5.2 Standing instruction modes
Player intent should distinguish at least three useful semantics: Do Once for a one-time action; Manager Judgment for
an ongoing delegated objective where the manager chooses ordinary means; and Owner Locked for a persistent
strategic prohibition or boundary that managers cannot override without explicit change.

5.3 Manager Activity remains visible
Autonomy is not invisible passive income. Manager reporting should expose material decisions, reasons,
authority/policy used, resulting commitments and exceptions. Routine activity can stay compact; unusual borrowing,
asset sales, owner-lock conflicts or strategic deviations may escalate according to policy.


                                          LAND & LEDGERS  4

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 005/346 ====================

5.4 Portfolio/general manager
A large portfolio may employ a Person to coordinate managers, screen opportunities, investigate property, arrange
suppliers/finance, reconcile cross-business priorities and route capital requests. This is real labor with finite attention,
information and authority, not a global automation bonus.

5.5 Employees may perform multiple compatible task families
A carpenter can construct when projects exist and perform repair/joinery when internal construction is idle. A smith can
alternate stocked fabrication, customer repair and farriery. Occupation profiles inform fit and evidence but do not lock
workers to one action family.

PART VI - PROPERTY, CONSTRUCTION, LUMBER & SETTLEMENT DEVELOPMENT

6.1 Mixed-use commercial/residential development
THE CROSSING validated the two-story storefront/residence as a useful but non-mandatory frontier form. Commercial
ground-floor space and upstairs housing can solve both premises and household accommodation for an entrepreneur,
but the building never determines which business may occupy it.

6.2 Autonomous property development
A property manager may investigate land, negotiate purchases/options, arrange ordinary financing, commission repeat
building types, recruit tenants, lease units, collect rent and service property obligations within delegated risk bounds.
Vacancy, weak inquiry, debt service, reserves and construction capacity are real brakes.

6.3 Land acquisition supports more than Buy
Acquisition workflows may include cash purchase, seller financing, mortgage/security, option, lease, parcel severance,
easement and other historically supported arrangements. Seller willingness remains causal; strategic land is not
automatically available.

6.4 Public-land interest remains distinct from title
Filing, lawful possession/claim, compliance, proof and patent remain separate states. Visually empty land is never
equivalent to claimable land, and an unperfected public-land claim cannot be treated as unrestricted fee-simple
inventory.

6.5 Generic construction business
A player may create a generic Business, hire carpenters/builders and then operate construction/repair activities from
actual tools, workers, materials and contracts. "Construction Company" is a useful description, not an action permission
class. Internal projects may receive priority while spare capacity is sold externally.

6.6 Lumber chain
A generic Business with log supply, mill machinery, fuel, workers, storage and hauling can function as a sawmill/lumber
supplier. Logs -> hauling -> milling -> lumber inventory -> hauling -> construction is a physical chain. Specialty
dimensions, finish stock, glass, roofing and other materials may still require outside procurement.

6.7 Vertical-integration savings must be causal
Owning carpentry, milling, smithing and freight can reduce outside markup and transaction cost only to the extent real
internal resources replace those purchases. No VerticalIntegrationCostReduction modifier is authorized.

6.8 Housing enables migration but does not create it
Rental houses and employer lodging create accommodation capacity. Population increases only after actual
Persons/Households decide, travel, arrive and establish residence. Employment and tenancy remain separate even
when the same Person participates in both.

PART VII - FREIGHT, STORAGE, FERRY & RIVER ENTERPRISE

7.1 Micro-freight entry remains valid
One teamster, two horses, one wagon, harness, feed/stabling access and route rights can support a legitimate local
carrier. A yard or warehouse is not required merely to haul freight.

7.2 Warehouse capacity is physical
CANON LOCK - A freight or forwarding business cannot store cargo merely because it exists. Warehousing requires
actual suitable space, capacity, access and handling labor/equipment. Building a warehouse can add consolidation,
staging, storage and handling services that were previously unavailable.



                                          LAND & LEDGERS  5

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 006/346 ====================

7.3 Livery, freight, ferry and river service are distinct activities
These activities may coexist in one Business or in dedicated Businesses because they perform different physical work.
Livery boards/feeds animals; freight sells cargo transport; ferry provides a crossing; warehousing stores/handles cargo;
river service provides trunk transport. Shared horses, wagons, workers, docks and spaces cannot be double-booked.

7.4 Internal transport policy
A controlled portfolio may set a $0 internal freight or ferry tariff. This removes internal cash charges but not the trip,
labor, feed, vessel time, wear, queueing or opportunity cost. External customers continue to transact according to
ordinary agreements.

7.5 Combined transportation enterprise
Ferry, wagon freight, drayage, warehousing, forwarding and river transport may become operations of one reorganized
Business when assets, contracts, employees, debts and cash authority are actually combined. An administrative
grouping alone does not perform that merger.

7.6 Staged river development is an example, not a tech tree
THE CROSSING progressed from landing -> forwarding relationships -> warehouse -> opposite-bank frontage ->
improved terminal -> chartered steamer capacity -> owned powered vessel. This is a validated systemic path, not a
required sequence. Players/NPCs may skip or reorder steps when real resources and opportunities permit.

7.7 Charter before ownership can create evidence
Leasing/chartering outside capacity can reveal actual volume, passenger demand, seasonality, rates, route imbalance,
fuel and scheduling needs before major capital purchase. The same evidence-first principle can apply to other
expensive equipment and facilities.

7.8 Seasonal navigation changes route state
Ice, flood, wind and navigation season affect actual crossing/river capacity and safety. Seasonal closure is not a
generic WinterRevenue penalty; route/service state changes first and the economy reacts afterward.

PART VIII - POULTRY, BIOLOGICAL PRODUCTION & FARM POLICY

8.1 Poultry lineage is operational state
Poultry must preserve parentage/source, fertility, incubation, hatch, sex when known, juvenile stage, mortality and
disposition. Breeding policy can deliberately rotate unrelated roosters before daughters enter the breeding group,
making lineage information economically useful rather than decorative.

8.2 Breeding flock and commercial laying flock
A poultry operation may prioritize reproduction while small, then shift toward a dedicated breeding group plus a larger
commercial laying group as productive scale grows. The exact transition threshold is scenario calibration, not a
universal flock-size rule.

8.3 Male birds remain physical
Cockerels are not deleted because they do not lay eggs. Surplus males can remain juveniles, be retained for breeding,
sold, slaughtered at appropriate size or otherwise disposed through ordinary systems.

8.4 Biological growth does not manufacture owner equity
Own-produced chicks, eggs, butter, crops, timber/firewood and similar outputs should not automatically create cash or
arbitrary mark-to-market profit. Sale, consumption, transfer and the chosen inventory/accounting method determine
recognized economic results.

PART IX - HISTORICAL EVENT CONFIGURATION & CAUSAL REGIMES

9.1 Historical Events setting
CANON LOCK - Scenarios that use researched named historical events expose a Historical Events setting. Default =
ON. When ON, applicable authored events/regimes may inject their dated, geographic causal inputs. When OFF, those
named authored events do not trigger merely because the calendar reaches the historical date.

9.2 Advanced individual overrides
An advanced configuration may permit individual named events/regimes to be enabled or disabled separately when
scenario design supports it. The setting belongs to scenario configuration/save state and must not retroactively rewrite
events that already occurred unless the user explicitly restarts/rebuilds the scenario.



                                          LAND & LEDGERS  6

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 007/346 ====================

9.3 Event effects remain causal
The Panic of 1873 remains the controlling example: credit appetite, lender failure, railway finance, projects, migration
and demand can change; the event may not directly post a universal percentage penalty. The Great Dakota Boom
similarly affects awareness, migration, land, finance, freight and business formation through ordinary systems.

9.4 Historical Events OFF is not No Adversity
Disabling authored historical events does not disable endogenous recessions, bank stress, disease, drought, blizzard,
fire, flood, crop failure or other outcomes generated by ordinary simulation. The toggle controls authored historical
injection, not causal simulation generally.

PART X - SCENARIO OBJECTIVES, ACCOUNTING & STATE DISCIPLINE

10.1 Objectives observe; they do not produce
Population, independent business, freight, passenger, ownership and equity objectives query authoritative state. They
do not create settlers, entrepreneurs, cargo, passengers, land, financing or revenue needed to satisfy themselves.

10.2 Historical/event objectives normally persist
Once a milestone such as first independent business, first household, cumulative freight or cumulative passenger
crossings is completed, it normally remains complete unless the objective explicitly states a maintained/current
condition.

10.3 Ownership predicates must be explicit
CANON LOCK - Objectives that require NPC-owned or independently owned businesses must exclude player-
controlled subsidiaries and other disallowed ownership structures according to the authored predicate. Joint ownership,
wholly player-owned, wholly NPC-owned and independent operation are not interchangeable.

10.4 Owner equity definition is scenario authority
Scenarios must explicitly define which starting assets, personal property, business interests, land interests, cash and
liabilities count toward owner equity. A supplied horse/tack or similar starting asset may not be inconsistently
included/excluded mid-campaign.

10.5 Debt funds assets but does not create equity
Borrowing can accelerate growth by financing real assets and working capital. Loan proceeds alone do not increase
owner equity because the corresponding liability remains. Objective equity uses the authoritative asset/liability
definition.

10.6 Land appreciation versus realized value
Estimated market value may be exposed analytically, but scenario objectives must state whether they use book/cost
basis, supported appraised transferable value, realized sale proceeds or another authoritative valuation rule. Town
growth may not silently mark land upward merely to satisfy an objective.

10.7 Explicit correction transactions
Detected ledger mistakes such as price transcription or omitted asset classification require explicit
adjustment/reconciliation provenance. They may not be silently rewritten in historical reports.

PART XI - NPC ENTERPRISE, PARTNERSHIP & SERVICE COMPOSITION

11.1 NPC entrepreneurs use the same generic Business architecture
A Person who sees unmet demand may investigate premises, capital, equipment, suppliers, staffing and customers
and then form a generic Business. The resulting observed identity - saddlery, bakery, dry goods, tinwork or other trade
- follows the same state-based doctrine as player Businesses.

11.2 Viability comes from reachable market, not town headcount
Resident population is only one source of demand. Rural farms, transient travelers, ferry traffic, freight teams,
surrounding settlements and route position can support a business that local headcount alone could not. No universal
Population >= X business formula is authorized.

11.3 50/50 silent partnership
Ownership percentage, capital contribution, profit/loss allocation and operating authority remain separate. A player may
hold 50 percent while another owner manages day-to-day operations. Material governance rights and approval
thresholds follow the actual agreement rather than ownership implying constant owner clicks.



                                          LAND & LEDGERS  7

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 008/346 ====================

11.4 Physician and pharmacy may be separate or combined
THE CROSSING used a physician tenant and separate player-owned druggist/pharmacy, which is valid but not
universal. Under generic-business doctrine, medical consultation and pharmacy/dispensing may be separate or
combined when actual ownership, people, premises, equipment, inventory, agreements and dated law support the
arrangement.

11.5 Contact graph extends beyond hiring
Known/contactable relationships can also generate tenant prospects, land opportunities, supplier introductions,
financing, partnership offers, specialists and migration leads. A request such as "Do you know anyone who..." should
query real relationships and may return no suitable lead.

PART XII - THE CROSSING PLAYTEST FINDING REGISTER
CROSS-CAN-001 Role describes; state permits. Person occupation and Business label are symmetrical descriptive layers,
not class permissions.
CROSS-CAN-002 Create Business is generic. Actual operations emerge from people, assets, space, inventory, rights,
agreements, information and time.
CROSS-CAN-003 Ordinary production is universally attemptable when physical prerequisites exist; specialist capability no
longer acts as a universal permission gate.
CROSS-CAN-004 Worker agency is independent of mechanical feasibility; assignment may still be refused or abandoned.
CROSS-DES-001 Retail assortment and storefront are activity/space state, not GeneralStore class authority.
CROSS-DES-002 BusinessOperation/CommercialCapability records may describe or organize work but cannot become
replacement hard classes.
CROSS-DES-003 Production policy supports enabled recipes, targets, maxima, input reserves, priorities and
make-to-order/stock behavior over real capacity.
CROSS-DES-004 Hiring uses a known/contactable Person graph and real channels rather than a global applicant pool.
CROSS-DES-005 Historical Events setting defaults ON and can disable authored named-event injection while preserving
endogenous simulation.
CROSS-VALID-001 Smithing hardware production consumed iron, fuel, worker time and forge capacity while reducing
outside purchases.
CROSS-VALID-002 Construction and sawmilling worked as generic Businesses whose observed identities followed owned
equipment and tasks.
CROSS-VALID-003 A mixed-use storefront/residence supported independent entrepreneur migration without dictating
business identity.
CROSS-VALID-004 Keller saddlery viability depended on rural/ferry/freight catchment, not seven local residents.
CROSS-VALID-005 Contact/referral provenance generated hires, tenants and specialists without spawning Persons.
CROSS-VALID-006 Full portfolio autonomy operated for extended periods with zero ordinary player management.
CROSS-VALID-007 Property development correctly paused when vacancies, leverage or reserves made further speculation
unattractive.
CROSS-VALID-008 Freight, ferry, warehouse, forwarding and river service coexisted as distinct physical activities inside one
reorganized Business.
CROSS-VALID-009 Chartered river capacity produced demand evidence before owned-vessel investment.
CROSS-VALID-010 Poultry breeding required lineage, sire rotation, maturation and disposition; commercial laying policy
changed as flock scale grew.
CROSS-VALID-011 Independent-business objectives required genuinely independent ownership and could not be satisfied
by player subsidiaries.
CROSS-VALID-012 Debt financed growth without itself increasing equity; property and enterprise value had to remain net of
associated liabilities.
CROSS-QA-001 Capability confidence formatting must be structurally validated: High one band, Moderate two adjacent, Low
three adjacent.
CROSS-QA-002 Ledger discrepancies must be corrected explicitly; narration/repetition is not reconciliation.
CROSS-QA-003 Scenario equity must define treatment of supplied starting assets before play begins.
CROSS-CAL-001 Exact rents, wages, land/building/vessel prices, interest, hatch rates, flock thresholds and profit levels
remain calibration only.

 • Exact production-time, quality, waste, injury and failure distributions by task, skill, equipment and supervision.
 • Exact period productivity and cost for hand-forged nails/hardware, small sawmills, frontier lumber quality and log-
   hauling chains.

 • Exact recruitment conversion, referral reach, mail/telegraph timing and evidence reliability by geography/date.
 • Exact employment terms, trial/probation practice, employer housing and guaranteed-work conventions by
   trade/place/date.
 • Exact land, rent, construction, warehouse, dock, ferry, freight and shallow-draft river-vessel economics by
   corridor/year.
 • Exact poultry fertility, incubation, mortality, maturity, laying curves and commercially rational breeding-group sizes by

 • Exact historical event severity/probability and local exposure. The configuration toggle changes authored-event

 • Exact valuation basis for scenario owner-equity objectives remains authored scenario policy; no universal mark-to-
  market rule is promoted.
 • Exact legal/licensing limits on medical, pharmacy, craft, transport and other activities remain LegalRegime data and
  can still make an otherwise physically possible action unlawful.

PART XIV - REVISION XXXI LOCK SUMMARY & DEEPENING MAP
 • Revision XXX Business Form Follows Actual Function doctrine is completed into a generic Business architecture.
  Labels, archetypes, BusinessOperation and capability registries may organize state but do not grant permissions.
 • Preserved occupation-is-descriptive and role-is-not-capability doctrine is mirrored at Business level: Person
  occupation does not determine what the Person may attempt; Business label does not determine what the Business
  may operate.
 • Preserved task/capability doctrine is superseded where it could be read as requiring specialist capability merely to
  attempt ordinary production. Capability instead modifies execution; worker agency and legality remain separate.
 • Existing Physicality, Task, Equipment, FunctionalSpace, Inventory, Agreement, Property, Logistics, Finance and
  LegalRegime authorities remain controlling and are reused rather than replaced.
 • Recruitment/referral doctrine is deepened into contact-graph employee selection, evidence-limited skill display and
   relationship provenance across hiring, tenants, suppliers, partners and migration.
 • Portfolio autonomy is deepened with explicit one-time versus Manager Judgment versus Owner Locked semantics
  and visible Manager Activity.
 • Property/construction doctrine is deepened with generic construction and lumber examples, causal vertical-
   integration savings, options/land assembly and vacancy-aware repeat development.
 • Freight/river doctrine is deepened with physical warehouse capacity, true business reorganization, combined
   transport activities, charter-before-ownership evidence and seasonal navigation.
 • Poultry lineage doctrine is deepened with sire rotation, breeding-versus-laying policy and explicit surplus-male
   disposition.
 • Historical regime doctrine is deepened with player/scenario configuration: Historical Events default ON, optional
   OFF/individual override, while all effects remain causal and endogenous incidents remain possible.
 • Scenario objective doctrine is deepened with explicit ownership predicates, persistent event milestones, scenario-
  defined equity treatment and no objective-generated state.

PRESERVATION GUARANTEE

Revision XXX preserves Canonical Project Bible Revision XXIX in full except where this integration explicitly adds, deepens,
clarifies, corrects or supersedes prior wording. The complete Revision XXIX document follows this integration unchanged
as the preserved historical layer. Where a conflict exists, Revision XXX controls. Exact playtest prices, wages, rents, traffic
counts, construction costs, loan balances, profit figures, capitalization thresholds, population dates and late-campaign
accounting totals remain calibration unless this revision explicitly promotes the underlying rule to Canon.

PURPOSE

Revision XXX integrates the complete MARKET TOWN playtest. The campaign tested a small service settlement
growing into a more mature town while the player delegated nearly all ordinary operations, built a rental-development
pipeline, formed a construction company, evolved a loan-and-exchange office into a private banking house, added
pharmacy/barber/butchery services, relied on NPC entrepreneurs for some missing businesses and allowed population to
mature through migration, aging, relationships, marriage, birth, illness and death.

The main result is not a fixed “best build order.” It is a set of stronger causal rules for portfolio autonomy, cash discipline,
rental development, bank governance, NPC enterprise formation, mixed-use professional premises, health-service demand
and generational continuity.

REVISION XXX MASTER DOCTRINE

 • Owner strategy can be expressed as persistent policies. Full Autonomy means managers act through ordinary authority,
   information, cash, labor and contracts rather than receiving hidden efficiency.

 • Cash, protected cash, debt, deposits, owner equity and business equity are different facts. Earmarking cash never
   creates a second cash balance.

 • Rental development is a causal loop: acquire lawful site, finance, build through real labor/materials, complete accommo-
   dation, recruit/lease, receive rent, service obligations and only then reinvest.

 • Housing can make migration feasible but never directly creates population. External-household preference is a player
   policy, not a population generator.

 • A player-owned construction company may prioritize internal capital projects and sell spare capacity externally. Internal
  work can capitalize real cost but cannot manufacture consolidated profit.

 • Finance can begin below full banking scale through own-account lending, note discounting/placement, collections,
  exchange and correspondent relationships. Public deposits introduce a new liability and liquidity problem.

 • A player-owned bank should expose deep policy control. Lawful limits should be visible; historically possible unlawful
   actions should generally remain performable when the player deliberately orders them, with evidence and consequences
  handled by LegalRegime/Enforcement rather than by an invisible prohibition.

 • NPC entrepreneurs use the same economic world. They may capture opportunities the player ignores, then become
   suppliers, customers, borrowers, tenants, employers, competitors or acquisition targets.

 • Growing settlement demand must propagate into real workload, queues, staffing, inventory and supplier relationships.
   Existing businesses do not process unlimited new demand with frozen staffing.

 • Health, injury and treatment are causal Person systems. Illness can remove labor availability, create physician/pharmacy
  demand and sometimes end in impairment or death.

 • Scenario objectives measure accomplishments. They should not secretly spawn the customers, households, businesses

PART I - PLAYTEST AUTHORITY, STATE DISCIPLINE & CALIBRATION

1.1 Design findings versus generated numbers

CANON LOCK - Playtest-generated economic values are evidence for calibration, not automatic Canon. A repeatable
 causal behavior may be promoted while the exact dollar amount, wage, rent, construction quote, interest balance,
 completion date or profitability remains scenario data until separately justified.

The MARKET TOWN campaign exposed several valuable systems while also exposing a serious text-simulation continuity
hazard. The campaign’s late narrative state was useful for design discovery, but an earlier unresolved accounting checkpoint
meant that exact downstream totals could not be treated as audited historical truth. Revision XXX therefore preserves
the systems findings while explicitly refusing to promote the exact soft-continuity late-campaign balances into canonical
calibration.

1.2 Reconciled checkpoints control exact state

CANON LOCK - An autonomous/text playtest may not silently continue exact financial or world-state claims from a
 checkpoint known to be unreconciled, voided or contradictory. Later exact balances derived from that checkpoint
 remain non-authoritative until the branch is replayed/reconciled or explicitly accepted as soft continuity. Design
 observations may survive when they do not depend on the disputed number.

Required discipline:

 • Never invent a balancing transaction merely to make a ledger close.

 • Never silently delete or recreate Persons, inventory, debt, leases, deposits, loans or ownership to repair continuity.

 • Objective completion dates that depend on equity, population, ownership or debt require authoritative supporting state.

 • A soft-continuity campaign can continue for design exploration, but reports must not later relabel those exact figures as
   audited truth.

1.3 Clear owner reporting

Player-facing long-run reports should present new playtest notes first, then date/population/objectives and a clear ledger.
At minimum distinguish:

 • owner-personal cash;

 • each business’s cash;

 • protected/committed cash inside that same balance;

 • principal debt and material liabilities;

 • bank customer deposits separately from ordinary debt;

 • consolidated owner equity separately from liquidity.

Equity is never presented as spendable cash.

PART II - PORTFOLIO AUTONOMY, OWNER ATTENTION & CAPITAL ALLOCATION

2.1 Full portfolio autonomy

A mature player may personally manage zero ordinary businesses. Managers can control routine staffing, procurement,
schedules, pricing within policy, ordinary maintenance, collections, customer service and small capital decisions when
authority permits. Owner attention is reserved for material exceptions, strategic changes, unusual borrowing, major asset
sales or explicit owner locks.

2.2 Persistent owner policies

Standing instructions can include reserve floors, reinvestment mandates, preferred lead routing, rental-first disposition,
internal-project priority, hiring boundaries, bank risk policy and escalation thresholds. Policies constrain delegated decisions
but do not create outcomes directly.





                                          LAND & LEDGERS  4

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 014/346 ====================

2.3 Operating reserves and owner sweeps

CANON LOCK - A wholly owned business may distribute excess cash after genuine operating, payroll, inventory,
 maintenance and debt needs are protected. Reinvesting that distribution into another controlled business is recorded
 as Business Distribution -> Owner Cash -> Owner Capital Contribution unless a real intercompany loan is explicitly
 intended. The movement creates no consolidated revenue or profit.

Reserve floors are targets/read models, not magical lockboxes. A manager may temporarily retain more cash when known
obligations justify it.

2.4 Settlement growth must alter workload

If population, transient traffic or rural catchment activity grows, existing businesses should experience the consequences
through actual customers, orders, inventory demand, queues, cleaning, bookkeeping, route load and employee time.
Managers may add workers, extend shifts or change supplier relationships only when telemetry supports it. The MARKET
TOWN saloon was a controlling example: more people increased patronage, but also increased bartender/server,
housekeeping, food, liquor and cleaning costs.

PART III - RENTAL HOLDINGS, HOUSING DEVELOPMENT & MIGRATION

3.1 Rental holdings as an autonomous property operation

A property business may own multiple residential and commercial assets while preserving per-property rent, debt, condition,
vacancy, maintenance and tax histories. A dedicated property manager may also perform third-party agency work under
real Agency/Management agreements; third-party property does not become player inventory.

3.2 Rental cash waterfall

The MARKET TOWN standing policy is promoted as a supported player-configurable pattern:

1. pay property-level operating obligations;

2. reserve enough actual cash for the next known property debt-service obligation according to policy;

3. retain maintenance/tax/contingency liquidity;

4. use genuinely uncommitted surplus toward the next acquisition, down payment or construction project.

CANON LOCK - A debt-service reserve is an earmark within authoritative cash, not a duplicate treasury balance.
 “Available cash” may subtract protected commitments for decision support, but only one cash authority exists.

3.3 Repeat-development authority

A property manager can be granted standing authority to investigate and acquire ordinary suitable residential sites and
repeat an approved development type within financing, price, reserve and risk bounds. Major departures - unusually large
projects, sale of core rental assets, extraordinary leverage or nonstandard ownership structures - may still escalate.

3.4 Housing and external migration

CANON LOCK - Housing does not increment population. A household becomes a permanent resident only through
 an actual migration/occupancy path: awareness or referral -> opportunity evaluation -> acceptable work/income path
 where needed -> available accommodation -> travel -> physical arrival -> residence stabilization.

The owner may prioritize external households when the strategic aim is population growth. Local households remain
eligible. External preference must not force indefinite vacancy when suitable local demand exists.

3.5 Build first, recruit near credible delivery

For speculative rental housing, aggressive recruitment should normally intensify when completion is close enough to be a
credible offer, rather than months before a highly uncertain project. Earlier awareness/referral can exist, but no tenant or
resident is guaranteed.

3.6 Employment, tenancy, construction labor and ownership remain separate

An employee may help build a dwelling that they later rent without acquiring equity. A tenant may work for another
employer. A buyer may purchase a completed house  if the owner chooses to sell.  These are separate Agree-
ment/Employment/Property relationships unless an explicit contract links them.




                                          LAND & LEDGERS  5

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 015/346 ====================

3.7 Rental-first does not mean sale-prohibited

The player may adopt a rental-first disposition policy while still authorizing sale when a buyer strongly prefers ownership
and the terms create an acceptable return or strategic benefit. A completed rental milestone remains historical unless the
scenario explicitly requires continued ownership.

3.8 Vacancy is a real brake

A successful first duplex does not prove infinite demand. Persistent vacancy, weak inquiry quality, inadequate reserves,
financing stress or construction bottlenecks can delay the next acquisition. Managers should respond to absorption
evidence rather than a perpetual-build flag.

3.9 Housing form can vary

Two independent dwellings on one property are a valid efficiency strategy when site, sanitation, household fit and economics
support it. The same policy can result in a duplex, two detached cottages or another historically appropriate configuration;
no single prefab is the rule.

PART IV - CONSTRUCTION AS AN INTERNAL CAPITAL PIPELINE

4.1 Internal-first construction company

A player-owned construction enterprise may operate under the policy “internal owner projects first, outside work with spare
capacity.” A foreman can schedule crews, specialists, materials and outside contracts autonomously within authority.

4.2 No manufactured internal profit

CANON LOCK - When a controlled construction company builds an asset for another controlled business, consoli-
 dated reporting preserves actual labor, material, transport, specialist and overhead cost while eliminating internal
 revenue/profit. The receiving property’s basis may capitalize legitimate project cost.

4.3 Physical time remains real

Repeated designs can reduce planning/rework modestly through familiarity, but they do not erase labor, material, weather,
specialist or logistics requirements. Construction timing should continue to use the Historical Work, Construction &
Infrastructure Calibration Reference as a calibration source, distinguishing active work from elapsed, lead/queue and
interruption time.

PART V - FROM LOAN & EXCHANGE OFFICE TO PRIVATE BANKING HOUSE

5.1 Capital-light finance is a legitimate early form

A small finance office may begin with own-account lending plus note/loan placement, collections, exchange/remittance,
correspondence and outside lender relationships. It need not accept public deposits on day one.

5.2 Outside-funded placements remain outside assets

CANON LOCK - When the office originates or services a loan funded and owned by an outside lender, the loan is
 not an asset of the player’s finance business and the lender’s funding is not the player’s cash. The office records its
 actual fees, servicing obligations and any retained exposure.

5.3 Conversion to deposit banking is a qualitative step

Transition from lender/exchange office to private banking house should depend on dated legality, genuine capital, capable
staff, secure records/premises, correspondent relationships, liquidity and market demand. No universal playtest dollar
threshold is Canon.

5.4 Deposits are liabilities

CANON LOCK - Public deposits create liabilities owed to depositors. Bank cash and correspondent balances protect
 withdrawals and settlement; loans and other earning assets can generate income while reducing immediate liquidity.
 Deposit growth is not owner wealth.

A bank panic or withdrawal burst should be resolved through actual liquid assets, correspondent access, loan maturities,
asset sales, new capital, suspension/failure rules and depositor behavior - never through a single reputation check.




                                          LAND & LEDGERS  6

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 016/346 ====================

5.5 Deep bank policy control

A player-owned bank should expose unusually deep control over:

 • liquidity/correspondent targets and withdrawal preparedness;

 • deposit products/terms where lawful;

 • rate/pricing policy within dated law;

 • collateral standards and appraisal evidence;

 • loan maturity preferences;

 • maximum borrower exposure and concentration by sector/location/collateral family;

 • connected-party lending policy;

 • approval thresholds and delegated lender authority;

 • delinquency, restructuring, enforcement and write-off policy;

 • dividends/retained earnings and capitalization;

 • staffing, opening hours, reconciliation and control procedures.

A single “Risk” or “Reserve” slider is insufficient.

5.6 Connected lending remains real

A bank loan to the owner or another controlled business is still a real loan on each entity’s books, with genuine underwriting,
collateral, liquidity and concentration implications. For consolidated owner reporting, the internal receivable/liability pair is
eliminated, while the bank-level exposure remains visible because depositors and bank solvency still care about it.

5.7 Intentional illegality

CANON LOCK - Where an action is physically and institutionally possible, the game should not generally protect the
 player from historically meaningful illegality by silently disabling the action. A player may deliberately direct unlawful
 deposit-taking, disclosure, lending, recordkeeping or other conduct when the dated LegalRegime defines it. The
 order/action creates evidence and can trigger employee refusal, concealment, discovery, civil/criminal exposure,
 closure, loss or reputation consequences according to the world state.

This is not permission for laws to become optional. It is a simulation rule: law operates through authority, evidence and
enforcement rather than invisible design rails.

PART VI - NPC ENTREPRENEURS, PRESSURE & COMMERCIAL NETWORKS

6.1 Opportunities are not reserved for the player

CANON LOCK - When unmet demand, supplier failure, congestion, customer travel or other evidence creates
 a business opportunity, an NPC entrepreneur may investigate and capture it through the same property, finance,
 staffing, inventory and information systems available to the player.

The independent bakery in MARKET TOWN is the controlling playtest example. The player did not open it, but it later
became a wholesale supplier to Pike Hall and a banking customer. An NPC business can therefore be competitor, supplier,
customer, borrower, tenant, employer or later acquisition target simultaneously.

6.2 Opportunity pressure should resolve causally

When a new NPC business successfully serves a missing need, the underlying pressure should change because real
transactions, supply and capacity changed - not because an Opportunity flag was manually cleared.

PART VII - MIXED-USE PROFESSIONAL SPACE, PHARMACY, BARBER & BUTCHERY

7.1 Mixed-use commercial buildings

One building may contain separate FunctionalSpaces used by distinct businesses. The MARKET TOWN health/trade
building combined a player-owned pharmacy, an independent physician’s consulting room and a player-owned barber
room. Shared structure does not merge cash, ownership, employees or service authority.





                                          LAND & LEDGERS  7

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 017/346 ====================

7.2 Pharmacy is both professional service and retail

A Druggist/Pharmacist requires actual capability, compounding/dispensing equipment, inventory, records and supplier
access. Pharmacy demand can arise from physician treatment, household self-purchase, injury care and ordinary retail
health demand.

7.3 Patent/proprietary medicines

CANON LOCK - Historically sold patent/proprietary medicines may be stocked and marketed when dated availability,
 supply and law support them. Product advertising claims, pharmacist belief and actual treatment effect remain
 separate facts. A cure-all does not gain medical efficacy because its label says so.

Exact inventory, formulation, toxicity, controlled-substance status and legal sale requirements remain dated research data.

7.4 Health-treatment chain

Illness or injury can create absence, reduced duty, physician/attendant tasks, pharmacy purchases, treatment, recovery,
lasting impairment or death. Treatment affects outcome only where the actual intervention plausibly matters. Owning a
doctor/pharmacy does not automatically prevent mortality.

7.5 Barber does not imply dentist

A Barber is primarily a grooming/service occupation. Dentistry remains a separate capability/profession. A particular
person may perform limited dental work only when evidence, capability, tools and the dated legal/social context support it;
the Barber title alone never grants dental treatment ability.

7.6 Whole-animal butchery remains controlling

Butcher economics continue to require allocation across desirable cuts, lower-value product, preservation, hides/tallow and
true waste/spoilage. Growing town demand can support a meat market, but no carcass becomes 100 percent premium
retail output.

PART VIII - DEMOGRAPHIC CONTINUITY & GENERATIONAL TOWNS

8.1 Existing children age into economic actors

CANON LOCK - Long-run simulation must periodically reconsider existing Persons as they age. A teenager can move
 from dependent/no formal work into family work, irregular paid work, apprenticeship or regular employment according
 to age, household need, law, opportunity, capability and local norms. There is no universal Age18CreatesWorker
 event.

8.2 Relationship formation and marriage

Older teenagers and young adults can form relationships, court, marry and create new households. Ages 18-19 are
possible but should not become the default center of the distribution merely because the simulation exposes them. Dated
law and calibrated demographic distributions govern eligibility and frequency.

8.3 Household split is not population growth

Two existing residents who marry and rent a new unit change household/occupancy structure but do not increase town
population. A spouse migrating from outside may increase population on arrival. The distinction must remain explicit.

8.4 Births and deaths are persistent Person events

Pregnancy schedules a possible later birth; birth creates a new Person. Death removes a living Person while preserving
historical identity, estate/kinship and business consequences. Population summaries are derived from actual living resident
Persons.

PART IX - SCENARIO DESIGN: THE MARKET TOWN & A TOWN FROM NOTHING

9.1 THE MARKET TOWN as a systems fixture

The campaign validated a scenario in which objectives primarily measure ownership, equity and settlement-population
accomplishments while the world creates difficulty through housing, labor, customers, lenders, competitors and physical
projects. Exact completion dates and generated late-campaign balances are not locked.





                                          LAND & LEDGERS  8

==================== CAN-XXXI ORIGINAL PDF PAGE 018/346 ====================

9.2 A TOWN FROM NOTHING / THE PROMOTER

CANON LOCK - The next scenario concept is preserved and deepened: begin at an effectively undeveloped remote
 site rather than inside an already functioning settlement. The scenario’s goals should focus on creating a durable town
 through lawful site control, access, structures, housing, employment, businesses/services, permanent households
 and institutions.

The starting world may contain distant farms, routes, legal land interests, external nodes and potential counterparties, but
it should not quietly provide the player with a complete service town. Scenario objectives must observe development; they
must not spawn guaranteed settlers or enterprises to satisfy themselves.

Objective families may include first lawful site/control, first permanent non-player household, first operating service business,
accommodation capacity, population milestones, independent/NPC enterprise formation, infrastructure access, durable
finance or other researched outcomes. Exact objective list and deadlines remain authored scenario data.

PART X - PLAYER-FACING UX DOCTRINE

10.1 Long-run report order

For autonomous simulation, surface new design/playtest notes first, then date/population/objectives, then the opening
ledger and major causal events. Routine manager activity can stay compact unless it creates an exception.

10.2 Ledger presentation

The default portfolio summary should show at least:

 • personal owner cash;

 • business cash by entity;

 • protected/committed portion where meaningful;

 • bank deposits and other material liabilities;

 • principal debt separately from accrued interest when material;

 • non-cash assets where needed to explain equity;

 • consolidated equity with a warning that it is not liquidity.

10.3 Bank UI

Bank management should provide both a compact health summary and drill-down views for liquidity, deposit liabilities,
maturity ladder, concentration, connected exposure, delinquency/workouts, correspondent balances, capital/equity and
legality warnings. The UI may warn that a proposed policy is unlawful without necessarily preventing deliberate execution.

PART XI - RESEARCH & CALIBRATION HOLDS

The following remain calibration/research rather than universal rules:

 • exact 1878-1884 wages, rents, residential land prices, construction costs, freight rates and business margins;

 • private banking capitalization needed for credibility/profitability in a specific settlement;

 • bank charter, examination, disclosure, reserve, insolvency and enforcement rules by exact jurisdiction/date/institution
   type;

 • exact probability, detection and consequences for unlawful banking behavior;

 • marriage-age distributions by region, sex, class/community and period, including early marriage tails;

 • illness/injury incidence, treatment efficacy, medicine availability, drug law and patent-medicine product catalogs by
   date/place;

 • service-entry thresholds for bakery, butcher, barber, pharmacy, dentist and similar businesses; use catchment evidence
   rather than population formulas;

 • rental vacancy, maintenance, taxes, insurance, financing, rent levels and development yields;

 • exact staffing thresholds for growing businesses; workload telemetry controls implementation;

 • exact migration response to available housing, jobs, kin/referrals and incentives;

 • exact construction timing; use task/scope-based historical calibration rather than one building timer.

PRESERVATION GUARANTEE

REVISION XXIX preserves Canonical Project Bible Revision XXVIII in full except where this integration explicitly adds,
deepens, clarifies, corrects or supersedes prior wording. The complete Revision XXVIII document follows unchanged as the
preserved historical layer. Where a conflict exists, Revision XXIX controls. Exact local prices, traffic counts, loss percentages,
adoption rates and procedural details remain dated evidence or calibration unless explicitly promoted to a Canon lock.

PURPOSE

Revision XXIX consolidates the frontier-history research developed after the 1870 historical-envelope work. It does not add
a disconnected event-card layer. Instead it maps public-land law, route change, environmental shocks, communications,
wholesale commerce, agricultural institutions, credit, insurance, cooperatives, distress and regional legal chronology onto
the existing Property, Agreement, Logistics, Information, Evidence, Finance, Institution, Project, Inventory, Person and
LegalRegime authorities.

REVISION XXIX MASTER DOCTRINE

 • Historical change normally alters physical resources, legal rights, routes, information, counterparties, credit or institutions
    first; prices, migration, profit and business survival react afterward.

 • Southeastern Dakota remains the strongest default Open Frontier anchor, but nearby Minnesota, Nebraska, northern
   Dakota, West River/Black Hills and selected Wyoming corridor scenarios may use the same systems with different historical
   priors.

 • Longitude alone never determines modernity. Corridor position, rail construction history, river crossings, outside markets
  and institutional access can make a farther-west location better connected than a nominally eastern one.

 • Public land is a family of legal processes. Filing, possession, compliance, proof, patent, railroad ownership, private title,
   lease, reservation/federal restriction and tax/creditor interests remain distinct states.

 • Rail, stage, ferry, river, wagon, mail, express and communications networks can create temporary boom corridors and can
    later strand or bypass investments without scripted town-death events.

 • Information latency is historical gameplay. The world may know a fact while the player, manager, lender or supplier learns
      it later through mail, newspaper, telegraph, telephone, commercial report, fair, traveling salesman or observation.

 • Mail order expands supplier discovery, not teleportation. Large goods still require payment, acceptance, freight/express
   movement, depot handling and local delivery.

 • Commercial credit, security interests, warehouse receipts, insurance, bankruptcy, tax sale and foreclosure are relation-
   ship/legal processes rather than generic debt or distress flags.

 • Cooperative and mutual capital formation is a reusable ownership/governance pattern that can support creameries,
   elevators, insurance, building-and-loan associations and communications networks.

 • Environmental shocks act through crops, animals, water, routes, buildings, inventory and worker availability. Historical
   events never authorize universal price/yield multipliers.

 • Sears kit houses are outside the 1905 Historical Horizon: Sears Modern Homes begin in 1908. Earlier movement of
   lumber, components and dismantled structures remains historically valid when actually sourced and transported.

PART I - REGIONAL GEOGRAPHY, CORRIDORS & HISTORICAL REGIMES

1.1 Default regional anchor and adjacent-world latitude

CANON LOCK - The default Open Frontier remains a Dakota-style southeastern frontier centered on Missouri/Sioux City-
oriented trade and a sparse 1870 local economy. Scenario authors may move the focal settlement roughly one regional step
east, south, north or west only after recalibrating actual rail chronology, water, settlement density, institutions, land law, market
access and outside nodes. The simulation may not carry a southeastern-Dakota starting template unchanged into another
state.

1.2 Historical regimes remain causal contexts

Revision XXV regime doctrine remains controlling. Revision XXIX deepens it with named event/institution cases. A regime
may change crop potential, credit appetite, route reliability, land demand, migration awareness, information speed or legal
options. It may not directly post revenue, customers, deaths, business failures or price percentages.
